```
08:00 PT - Blog goes live (link)
08:05 PT - CEO short quote (X, LinkedIn)

10:55 PT - Stream reminder (11:00 PT)
```

sara: Confirmed. Also flagged one supporting graph for accuracy; updated PNG in the pack.
mike: Fallback headline options in the pack: "Redwood benchmark: inference economics update" OR "New Redwood benchmark and tooling for efficient inference"
